title: How to Build a Research Panel: A Step-by-Step Guide (2026)
summary: How to recruit, segment, and run your first research panel — without spreadsheets. A step-by-step guide with templates and recruitment tactics.
body_markdown: Ned is the co-founder and CEO of Great Question. He has been a technology entrepreneur for over a decade and after three successful exits, he’s founded his biggest passion project to date, focused on customer research. With Great Question he helps product, design and research teams better understand their customers and build something people want.
